task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Odoo CRM or Contacts module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo dashboard or the Contacts/CRM list view.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the 'Company' radio button/option for the new contact.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Company' radio button is selected in the contact creation form, rather than 'Individual'.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the correct company name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The name field contains 'Meridian Financial Group'.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the email and phone number correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The email field shows 'info@meridianfinancial.com' and the phone field shows '+1 (212) 555-0847'.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the city and country correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The city field shows 'New York' and the country dropdown/field shows 'United States'.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the new contact record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the 'Save' button (cloud icon or 'Save' text) and the record transitions from an edit state to a read-only view or a success notification appears.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons in the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by simply navigating to a pre-existing URL of a finished record.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step typing of data into the form fields.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Odoo instance and not a static image or mock-up.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI responds to clicks (e.g., dropdowns opening, page loading indicators).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The contact must be created as a 'Company' (not an individual). Required values: Name: 'Meridian Financial Group', Email: 'info@meridianfinancial.com', Phone: '+1 (212) 555-0847', City: 'New York', Country: 'United States'. The task is only successful if the record is saved and these specific values are visible in the final state.
